title: Ceftriaxone induces glial EAAT-2 promotor region via NF-kB conformational changes: An interaction analysis using HADDOCK.
authors: Rao, Gaddam Narasimha; Jupudi, Srikanth; Pant, Pradeep; Palathoti, Nagarjuna; Rajagopal, Kalirajan; Govindasamy, Rathika; Justin, Antony
one_liner_zh: 该文用HADDOCK对接和MD模拟研究头孢曲松诱导NF-kB与EAAT-2启动子DNA的构象变化，属于TF-DNA互作建模，但对象非典型TF且偏药物机制，方法可迁移。
abstract: Excitotoxicity, depletion of energy metabolites, and ionic imbalance are the major factors involved in neurodegeneration mediated through excitatory amino acid transporter-2 (EAAT-2) dysfunction in ischemic insult. Recent studies have revealed that ceftriaxone expresses EAAT-2 via nuclear transcription factor kappa-B (NF-kB) signaling pathway, stimulation of EAAT-2 expression in the ischemic, and excitotoxic conditions that could provide potential benefits to control neurodegeneration. In this study, we have predicted the in silico model for interaction between NF-kB and EAAT-2 promoter region to rule out the conformational changes for the expression of EAAT-2 protein. Using homology-built model of NF-kB, we identified ceftriaxone-induced conformational changes in gene locus -272 of DNA where NF-kB binding with EAAT-2 promoter region through protein-DNA docking calculation. The interaction profile and conformational dynamics occurred between ceftriaxone predocked and postdocked conformations of NF-kB with DNA employing HADDOCK 2.2 web server followed by 250 ns long all atom explicit solvent molecular dynamics simulations. Both the protein and DNA exhibited modest conformational changes with respect to HADDOCK score, energy terms (desolvation energy [E(desolv) ]), van der waal energy (E(vdw) ), electrostatic energy (E(elec) ), restraints energy (E(air) ), buried surface area, root mean square deviation, RMSF, radius of gyration, total hydrogen bonds when ceftriaxone pre- and postdocked NF-kB conformations were bound to DNA. Hence, the conformational changes in the C-terminal domain could be the reason for EAAT-2 expression through ceftriaxone specific binding pocket of -272 of DNA.
abstract_zh: 兴奋性毒性、能量代谢物耗竭及离子失衡是缺血性损伤中通过兴奋性氨基酸转运体-2（EAAT-2）功能障碍介导神经退行性变的主要因素。近期研究表明，头孢曲松通过核转录因子kappa-B（NF-kB）信号通路表达EAAT-2，在缺血及兴奋性毒性条件下刺激EAAT-2表达，这可能为控制神经退行性变提供潜在益处。在本研究中，我们预测了NF-kB与EAAT-2启动子区域相互作用的计算机模拟模型，以排除EAAT-2蛋白表达中的构象变化。利用NF-kB的同源建模结构，我们通过蛋白-DNA对接计算，识别了头孢曲松诱导的DNA基因位点-272处的构象变化，其中NF-kB与EAAT-2启动子区域结合。采用HADDOCK 2.2网络服务器，随后进行250 ns长的全原子显式溶剂分子动力学模拟，分析了头孢曲松预对接和对接后NF-kB构象与DNA之间的相互作用谱及构象动力学。当头孢曲松预对接和对接后NF-kB构象与DNA结合时，蛋白质和DNA均表现出适度的构象变化，涉及HADDOCK评分、能量项（去溶剂化能[E(desolv)]）、范德华能（E(vdw)）、静电能（E(elec)）、约束能（E(air)）、埋藏表面积、均方根偏差、RMSF、回转半径及总氢键数。因此，C末端结构域的构象变化可能是通过头孢曲松特异性结合DNA -272位点口袋而表达EAAT-2的原因。
